posts.name: Ret
posts.cooked:
Yes, but a network of 50+ bot accounts running on virtual machines is going to be slowed down significantly by rating requirements or other things that require the botters to adapt their software to new prevention systems put in place.

From what I have heard, the reddit video you linked is a promotional video for botting software for rogues only. While there are lots of rogue bots out there, there are also other bots that are not rogues. Furthermore, someone using this software in an arena environment can easily be found out.

It may not be practical or efficient for bot networks to queue up to obtain a certain rating requirement on all their characters. The majority of bots aren’t going to be able to beat the majority of players in arena to achieve a that many players can get, let alone find a partner other than another DK or rogue bot.

So greatly slowing the progress of these botted characters’ power levels and effectiveness is going to help aide even the most humble of players in beating the bots that actually queue up, just from a gear difference alone. It’s important to have something that is obtainable by the majority of players but not obtainable by the majority of bots.
